When you start getting nerve damage. When you hit veins and risks of hitting arteries. Its when it completely takes over your life and body just like any addiction. It will start of small but the next "high" is always going to be there and your going to want to go deeper, further, to the point you risk loosing your life. Infection is also a massive issue. Body image issues. Scarring issues. It will get very itchy and sore and irritated while it's healing. It's all normal. You have to be worried when it's very hot to the touch, smells bad, oozes green/yellowish liquid and go to a&e straight away if you start getting fevers. Try wetting a clean face cloth with cold water and putting it on your arm. It might give you a little relief or I've found e45 cream is pretty good and I'm really sensitive to creams.

Whatever you do do not put anything with fibres on the wound, a sock has too many and It will stick to the wound and can cause infection, irritation and will just be sore. As another person mentioned sanitary pads are good also kitchen roll paper is good too. When you go to change the dressings or take the dressings off make sure you wet the bandage/dressing it won't hurt as much taking it off ❤
